source_sha256: <sha256 of sN-raw-indexed.md at the time the decisions were made>

session_cutoff.reason: Quote the GM's end-of-session call and state which line carries the final in-character beat. Track A prose must not continue past `line` (FP-17).

scope: One sentence: which high-risk spans were reviewed (naming, collaborative lore, contested actions). This is a forensic reference, not a classification of every turn.

decisions.contributor: Player or GM name exactly as printed in sN-raw-indexed.md
decisions.function: Short label: naming joke, campus motto, unplayed cliffhanger, ...
decisions.representation: tentative (optional; use when a proposed idea may be rendered only as a question or hedge)
decisions.reason: Why the line lands where it does, citing the surrounding turns. Never assign a table proposal to a character as spoken dialogue.
